day_shape: 61 items dominated by US-Iran MoU fallout: E4+ leaders' joint statement on the peace deal, Trump confirms IAEA/US inspector access, Strait of Hormuz diplomacy via Oman/Qatar/UAE, Israel-Lebanon talks resume in Washington, and heavy Ashura/12-day-war messaging on Iranian state channels.

threads.label: US-Iran deal: E4+ backing and IAEA access
threads.summary: The UK, France, Germany, Italy and 30+ other states issued a joint E4 leaders' statement on the 14 June US-Iran peace deal, while Trump confirmed IAEA and US inspectors will be allowed into Iran to locate enriched uranium. IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said inspectors would visit enrichment sites under the MoU; the Pentagon told senators it needs roughly $80 billion largely to cover the US war against Iran.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz diplomacy
threads.summary: Rubio met UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed in Abu Dhabi to discuss the Trump-Iran MoU and safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz; Qatar's PM told the FT a US-Iran hotline was essential to reopen the strait. Trump said Iran told Washington no tolls were being sought from ships, and Oman and Iran agreed to pursue talks on future administration of the strait.

threads.label: Iran oil exports and sanctions easing
threads.summary: Tanker Trackers reported Iran has exported 40 million barrels of crude since 15 June, with half shipped on 19 June alone; IRIB amplified the figure. Iran's Oil Minister Paknegad said Iran has a 60-day sanctions exemption under understandings with Washington and is ready to expand cooperation with India.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon negotiations and southern Lebanon strikes
threads.summary: A second day of Israel-Lebanon talks began in Washington, with the EU diplomatic service proposing a three-year military and civilian training mission for Lebanese forces, and Samir Geagea asking JD Vance to separate Lebanon from Iran negotiations. The IDF struck two Hezbollah gunmen near Ali al-Taher ridge and a vehicle near Kafr Rouman that Lebanese media said killed two, while Hezbollah's Naim Qassem demanded full Israeli withdrawal.

threads.label: Gaza operations and postwar planning
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed October 7 infiltrator Akram Abu Mazi in a Sunday strike in southern Gaza, struck four rocket-launching positions built during the ceasefire, and detained an unarmed suspected Hamas operative at Kerem Shalom. Walla reported negotiations with Israeli companies on large-scale demolition in Gaza, while Board of Peace representatives are to convene in Cyprus next week; UK Foreign Secretary announced child medical evacuations and university places for Palestinians.

threads.label: Iranian regional diplomacy and OIC messaging
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi spoke by phone with his Saudi counterpart on the negotiation process, and told Hamas's Basem Naim that Iran was raising Israeli aggression in Gaza in talks with the US. Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf, returning from an OIC parliamentary session in Baku, said regional security should be decided by regional countries alone and claimed on IRIB that American hegemony had "collapsed" in the 12-day war.

threads.label: Iranian state-channel Ashura and 12-day war messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran heavy Day of Ashura coverage from Qom and the shrines of Hazrat Ma'suma and Hazrat Abbas, alongside the twelfth episode of "Self-Healing Fortress" on the final hours of the 12-day war. IRIB carried a Red Crescent paramedic's account of being struck while marked, and amplified John Mearsheimer claiming Trump signed a deal disadvantageous to America to avert economic catastrophe.

events.title_en: Mohammad Javad Mohebbian, Iranian national judo champion, dies
events.summary_en: Mohammad Javad Mohebbian, Iranian national judo champion, dies. Mohammad Javad Mohebbian, the distinguished champion judo player of the country and member of the national team of the Islamic Republic of Iran, passed away on the Day of Ashura due to a terminal illness. This judo player from Qom achieved notable accomplishments in his sports career including winning the youth and young adult age group championship of the country, second place in the 2023 Asian youth championship and third place in international competitions in Russia. Mohammad Javad Mohebbian was also a member of the national team in youth, young adult and senior age groups.

events.title_en: 'They struck us with the Red Crescent mark': Account of a survivor of the 12-day war
events.summary_en: 'They struck us with the Red Crescent mark': Account of a survivor of the 12-day war. Behnam Hazrati-Fard, a Red Crescent paramedic: We were planning to transfer the body of our martyred colleague when suddenly... All I remember is a sudden wave of heat, a whistling sound by my ear and nothing else. The enemy observed no protocol. Our ambulance and uniforms clearly bore the Red Crescent mark which, according to international conventions, is protected from attack. But in a cowardly manner they targeted us.

events.title_en: Near the security zone: IDF attacks two armed Hezbollah militants who posed a threat to our forces in the Ali al-Tahir hill area
events.summary_en: Near the security zone: IDF attacks two armed Hezbollah militants who posed a threat to our forces in the Ali al-Tahir hill area. Forces from the Giv'ati Brigade operating in the Ali al-Tahir heights spotted this morning two armed terrorists from Hezbollah who posed a threat to our forces operating in the security zone. Upon spotting the terrorists, the air force and forces in the field targeted them to eliminate the threat. The IDF will not allow Hezbollah terrorists to harm the citizens of the State of Israel or IDF forces, and will continue to work to eliminate immediate threats.

events.title: Two Hezbollah gunmen were targeted in an Israeli strike this morning after being identified near troops in southern Lebanon, the military says. The IDF says troops of the Givati Brigade's Reconnaissance Unit, operating in the Ali Taher ridge area near Nabatieh, spotted the two armed Hezbollah operatives, who "posed a threat to forces operating in the security zone." The Israeli Air Force and the troops then struck the operatives "to remove the threat," the military adds.
events.summary:
Two Hezbollah gunmen were targeted in an Israeli strike this morning after being identified near troops in southern Lebanon, the military says.

The IDF says troops of the Givati Brigade's Reconnaissance Unit, operating in the Ali Taher ridge area near Nabatieh, spotted the two armed Hezbollah operatives, who "posed a threat to forces operating in the security zone."

The Israeli Air Force and the troops then struck the operatives "to remove the threat," the military adds.— Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian (@manniefabian) Jun 24, 2026

events.title: An unarmed suspected Hamas operative was detained by Israeli soldiers after approaching the Kerem Shalom border crossing in the southern Gaza Strip earlier, the military says. Troops were dispatched to the area "following suspicion of the presence of a Hamas terrorist on the Gaza side of the crossing," the IDF says. The soldiers detained the suspect and took him for further questioning. "The details and identity of the suspect are currently under review," the army says. The IDF says it also "emphasizes that there was no infiltration into Israeli territory" during the incident.
